sourceRecords.title: Orient Cable Installs China First 66 kV Dynamic Line for Floating Wind
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Orient Cable installed the subsea cable for CTG 16 MW floating wind demonstration platform. The source states this was China first 66 kV dynamic cable for floating wind and that NBO scope included design, supply and installation.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Independent Review Confirms Windeed's Floating Wind Cost Advantage
sourceRecords.sourceText: Windeed reported that BVG Associates independently assessed its floating foundation and mooring system and found its LCOE materially lower than typical second-generation floating wind designs on a like-for-like basis.

briefingItems.title: Windeed review claims lower-cost floating wind system
